<script>
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
const fmtDate = d => `${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${pad(d.getDate())}/${d.getFullYear()}`;
const fmtDateTime = d => `${fmtDate(d)} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;

// Same day next month; clamps to the last day (e.g. Jan 31 -> Feb 28)
function oneMonthLater(d) {
  const r = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1, 1);
  const lastDay = new Date(r.getFullYear(), r.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  r.setDate(Math.min(d.getDate(), lastDay));
  return r;
}

function updateTicketDates() {
  const now = new Date();
  $("created").textContent  = fmtDateTime(new Date(now.getTime() - 2 * 60 * 1000));
  $("updated").textContent  = fmtDateTime(now);
  $("startDate").textContent = fmtDate(now);
  $("expDate").textContent   = fmtDate(oneMonthLater(now));
}

updateTicketDates();                                   // run on page load
$("qrBlock").addEventListener("click", updateTicketDates);  // and on every tap

// Shrink the pages to fit narrow screens (phones)
function fit() {
  const z = Math.min(1, (document.documentElement.clientWidth - 16) / 816);
  document.querySelectorAll(".wrap").forEach(w => {
    w.style.width = 816 * z + "px";
    w.style.height = 1056 * z + "px";
    w.firstElementChild.style.transform = `scale(${z})`;
  });
}
window.addEventListener("resize", fit); fit();
</script>
